method: Manual inspection of every follow-up parsed proposal, against captured state/observations and the older exchange; these notes identify notable defects, not a complete semantic validator.

notable_trials.r12-split_json: Fresh locations retained, but attributes kwargs assignment at line 255 to _run_step, although the observation places it under run_step.
notable_trials.r18-split_json: Fresh locations retained; again attributes line 254-255 handling to _run_step instead of run_step.
